tools.name: get_cedwyn_guide
tools.description: Return the site's llms.txt: what the archive is, how outside records are treated, and where every section lives. Read this first.

tools.name: search_cedwyn_names
tools.description: Search the published nomenclature register (Tŷ Mawr, Great House Farm, Cedfin/Cedwyn and every recorded spelling). Returns the concept, variant, first record year, catalogue source id and page path. Matches are retrieval aids, not proof that two places are identical.

tools.name: list_cedwyn_ebooks
tools.description: List the e-books published at /ebooks/ with their titles and page paths (free and paid editions are explained on each page).

tools.name: read_cedwyn_page
tools.description: Fetch one public page of cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate by path (e.g. /ebooks/enwau/ or /values/) and return its title, headings, plain text (max 20,000 characters) and same-site links.

tools.name: get_catalogue_export
tools.description: Return the open-data export of the central evidence database: tables, row counts, columns and the download path and SHA-256 of every CSV file.

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: Return the SHA-256 list of the published catalogue export and discovery files, anchored with OpenTimestamps on 5 Nov 2026, and how to verify a file yourself.

tools.name: list_open_agent_jobs
tools.description: Return the Cedwyn Academy work board: open, claimable research jobs with definitions of done.
